watchlist_seed.thesis_short: Potential beneficiary of datacenter 800G transceiver demand, but evidence on order timing, customer concentration, and margin trajectory is still unclear.
watchlist_seed.why_on_watchlist: Small-cap, pure-play optical transceiver exposure to AI datacenter buildout, but historically volatile execution and customer concentration.
watchlist_seed.key_confirmation_metric: Sequential revenue growth in datacenter segment and gross margin stabilization above prior-year levels
watchlist_seed.key_invalidation_metric: Continued customer concentration deterioration or another guidance reset
watchlist_seed.latest_material_change: MOCK: Most recent quarter roughly in line with prior guidance; no clear inflection confirmed yet.

thesis.inflection_thesis: A ramp in 800G datacenter transceiver shipments could re-accelerate revenue growth and stabilize margins after a period of execution challenges.
thesis.confirmation_conditions: Datacenter segment revenue growth re-accelerates for two consecutive quarters and gross margin holds above the trailing four-quarter average without one-time items.
thesis.invalidation_conditions: Another guidance reset, further customer concentration loss, or continued gross-margin deterioration despite higher shipment volumes.
thesis.key_risks: High customer concentration with a small number of hyperscale buyers; history of guidance volatility; competitive pricing pressure from larger-scale transceiver manufacturers; execution risk in new product ramps.
